controls.nativePrerenderAges: Clocked native artifacts intentionally differ; no native-binary byte reproducibility claim.
controls.metadata: Validator implementation and differential tests change source fingerprints and lazy-module digest strings. Exact gzip deltas include these legitimate metadata changes; same Go/VCS/flag settings and support bytes are independently checked.
